clips.name: Bukayo Saka
clips.caption: Player wearing a red England shirt with dark/navy trim, navy shorts and red socks; visible England crest on the chest and squad number 7 on the shorts and front of the shirt. Short, tightly curled black hair, athletic/muscular build; image shows match action with the player dribbling the ball on the pitch. No visible commercial sponsor on the shirt.

clips.name: Bukayo Saka

He has short, tightly curled dark hair, a lean athletic build, and is wearing dark navy shorts. Image is match action on the pitch (outdoor stadium) rather than a posed portrait.
